implementation.compatibility_classification: IBM TSO/E and VM non-SAA REXX built-in
implementation.approach: Two-required-argument wrapper constructs a local descriptor pair [phrase,string] and calls rexx_builtin_wordpos with argument count 2. It uses WORDPOS default start and rejects a third argument through FIND descriptor validation. No distinct search engine, tokenizer, or search-buffer allocation.
implementation.result: One-based word index of the first consecutive whole-word phrase match; 0 when absent or phrase contains no words.
implementation.normalization: Uses the existing WORDPOS word scanner and byte-separator class (ASCII space and tab through carriage return); runs of separators normalize for word comparison.
implementation.case_punctuation_bytes: Case-sensitive exact byte matching; punctuation, NUL, nonprintable, and high-bit bytes remain data unless a byte is an existing separator.
implementation.limits: Existing search-work bounds and 16 MiB runtime string limit retained; no Unicode, DBCS, locale, or EBCDIC translation claim.
implementation.binary_literal_note: RX16 X-literal grouping blanks are discarded. The packed bytes in '80 00FF 41'X form one word; an actual blank byte must be concatenated to create a word boundary.
